list: Official 55 trophies, as published for PlayStation 5. Names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them; every guide below is written in our own words for this entry.

exo: Exophase — Official GTA VI trophy list

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies first — this one pops automatically when the last of them lands.
Use the checklist here to find your final gaps: the Next up panel always shows the closest one.
Most hunters finish with A Long Road (100% completion), so plan the collectible and challenge grind last.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first story mission of the game.
Follow the on-screen objectives through the mission from start to finish.
The trophy pops the moment the mission completes; nothing optional is needed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 1 in order.
Side content is not required for this trophy — the chapter banner is what counts.
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 1 mission ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 2 in order.
Finish any missable mission trophies in this chapter while you are there (see the Missables tab).
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 2 mission ends.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 3 in order.
Clear the Chapter 3 mission trophies (Headliners, VCIA Takedown) as they come up.
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 3 mission ends.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through every story mission in Chapter 4 in order.
Finish Operation Savage Glory while you are in this chapter.
The trophy pops when the final Chapter 4 mission ends, opening the finale.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish Chapter 4 to unlock the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end — it is the last story beat of the game.
The gold trophy pops at the final cutscene; the credits roll afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story.
Complete it in full — the trophy is tied to this one mission only.
Point of return: the last story mission before Breakfast Run. If you pass it, replay the mission from mission replay if the game offers it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the mission The Cartel Heist when it appears in the story.
Complete the heist from planning to getaway — the trophy is tied to this one mission only.
Point of return: the last story mission before The Cartel Heist. If you pass it, replay the mission from mission replay if the game offers it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the mission Child's Play when it appears in the story.
Complete it in full — the trophy is tied to this one mission only.
Point of return: the last story mission before Child's Play. If you pass it, replay the mission from mission replay if the game offers it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the mission Headliners when it appears in the story.
Complete it in full — the trophy is tied to this one mission only.
Point of return: the last story mission before Headliners. If you pass it, replay the mission from mission replay if the game offers it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the mission VCIA Takedown when it appears in the story.
Complete it in full — the trophy is tied to this one mission only.
Point of return: the last story mission before VCIA Takedown. If you pass it, replay the mission from mission replay if the game offers it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory when it appears in the story.
Complete it in full — the trophy is tied to this one mission only.
Point of return: the last story mission before Operation Savage Glory. If you pass it, replay the mission from mission replay if the game offers it.

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first — most of the 100% checklist opens as you play.
Work the checklist in the in-game stats screen: missions, collectibles, challenges, activities and exploration all feed the total.
Leave this for last; it is normally the final trophy before the platinum pops.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Stunts count from jumps, airtime, near-misses and similar driving feats in free roam.
Chain them on long highway runs — ramps and jumps reset the flow fastest.
Use the counter stepper here to log your running total; the trophy pops at 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description does not name the activity types, and the full list of 9 types is not confirmed from the official list alone — the count of 9 comes from the guide sources cited below.
steps: Try one of each activity type the game offers — shooting range, drone races, races, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest.
Work through the activities tab one by one; each first try ticks the count.
The trophy pops once every type has been tried at least once.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Open the Shooting Range and work through its 42 challenges one by one.
Each challenge needs a gold-medal score — repeat a challenge until the gold threshold clears.
Steady aim beats speed: take the time bonus shots only once your grouping is tight.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Find the Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations across Leonida.
Win a race at a location to tick it off — a win anywhere else does not count for that spot.
Learn each course once before racing it flat-out; the tight gates punish blind speed.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the count.
Vary the race types and locations so each win is a new one.
Use the counter stepper here to track which races you have already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge and take him on head-to-head.
Outscore him across the challenge rounds — steady reeling beats frantic casting.
Point of return: challenge Cal before you finish the fishing storyline; replay the challenge if the game offers it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Walk into any arcade in Leonida and pick a machine.
Play one arcade game through to its end screen — any game counts.
Pick the shortest game on your first run; the trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Take on Andy's missions in the order they appear.
Each mission unlocks the next — work the whole strand, not just the last one.
The trophy pops when Andy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Take on Kenton's missions in the order they appear.
Each mission unlocks the next — work the whole strand, not just the last one.
The trophy pops when Kenton's final mission completes.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Take on Billy's missions in the order they appear.
Each mission unlocks the next — work the whole strand, not just the last one.
The trophy pops when Billy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Watch for stranger markers across the state of Leonida as you explore.
Complete 8 full stranger strands — a single mission does not count, the whole strand does.
Use the counter stepper here to track the strands you have finished.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Take on Randy's missions in the order they appear.
Each mission unlocks the next — work the whole strand, not just the last one.
The trophy pops when Randy's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Take on Tyrone's missions in the order they appear.
Each mission unlocks the next — work the whole strand, not just the last one.
The trophy pops when Tyrone's final mission completes.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
steps: Find the meditation spots scattered across Leonida — quiet overlooks and calm corners.
Meditate at each of the 18 spots; a spot counts once the meditation completes.
Use the counter stepper here to track the spots you have already done.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description names Bret and a unique animal, but the animal and its hunting ground are not confirmed from the official list alone — see the sources cited below.
steps: Start Bret's strand and follow it until the hunt is offered.
Track the unique animal Bret asks for and take it down cleanly.
Point of return: Bret's strand itself — finish the hunt before the strand closes.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collectible cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots.
A set completes when every card in it is found; you need 3 full sets.
Use the counter stepper here to track completed sets, not single cards.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: WAiNK It is a photo-style check-in at marked spots across Leonida.
Hit 100 different locations — repeats at the same spot do not count.
Fold it into your exploration route so it finishes alongside the map grind.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenges list in the pause menu and pick the easiest ones first.
Challenges stack with normal play — stunts, races and exploration all feed them.
The trophy pops at 50 completed; the counter stepper here tracks your total.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Play with your partner beside you, then build a 4-star wanted level together.
Break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear.
Point of return: any partner free-roam session works — but do it before the story strands that change partner availability.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: Plan a route through 3 shops close together, with your partner beside you.
Rob each shop in turn without letting the wanted level drop between robberies.
Point of return: do it in one partner session — if the wanted level clears, the chain resets and you start over.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: A vehicle counts the first time you drive it — new models only.
Sweep car parks, dealerships and traffic in every district to find new models.
The counter stepper here tracks your running total toward 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Pick a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and chain the takedowns before the meter runs out.
If the count falls short, the attempt resets — set up a denser fight and try again.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description says only an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the exact vehicle and exit are not confirmed from the official list alone.
steps: Head to VCIA, the Vice City airport, in free roam.
Leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned — an aircraft departure outside the normal flow.
The trophy pops when the departure registers; see the sources cited below for the method hunters use.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description is a joke line about Rhinos (tanks) — the exact feat it tracks is not confirmed from the official list alone.
steps: Rhinos are the tanks of Leonida — find one in the world or in a wanted-level escalation.
Do what the trophy asks with a Rhino: survive its heat and use it.
Check the sources cited below for the method hunters have confirmed.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and case it first — note the cameras, staff and exits.
Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm, no detection at any point.
Grab the goods and leave clean; the trophy pops on a fully undetected robbery.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find the bank vaults across Leonida and plan each robbery in turn.
Crack the vault, grab the cash and escape the response — the escape counts, not just the entry.
Repeat for 5 vaults; the counter stepper here tracks each clean getaway.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Find an armored truck on the roads of Leonida and stop it.
Break into the truck and take the cash inside.
Escape the response afterwards — the trophy pops on a clean getaway, not on the stop alone.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Drive through all 52 areas of Leonida — every district and stretch of countryside.
Use the in-game map to spot the areas you have not visited yet.
The counter stepper here tracks areas explored toward 52.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Each of the 9 gangs runs illegal operations somewhere in Leonida.
Rob one operation per gang — the same gang twice does not add to the count.
The counter stepper here tracks how many gangs you have already hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description names Ocean Beach and a cocktail with a view — the exact bar or spot is not confirmed from the official list alone.
steps: Head to Ocean Beach on the Vice City waterfront.
Find a spot with a view and order a cocktail there.
The trophy pops when the drink and the view come together; see the sources cited below.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description names a vehicle showroom — which showroom and the exact smash are not confirmed from the official list alone.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom in Vice City and take a car inside it.
Smash your way out through the showroom front in classic style.
The trophy pops on the breakout; see the sources cited below for the spot hunters use.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game there and follow through on your throws.
The trophy pops at the alley once the game is done.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description is deliberately vague — what counts as a partnership with mass appeal is not confirmed from the official list alone.
steps: Play partner activities and build the partnership's public profile.
Keep at the partner strand until the mass-appeal moment triggers.
Check the sources cited below for what hunters have confirmed counts.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Story choices add up across the whole game — the tracker counts toward 500.
Make choices whenever the story offers them; both good and bad outcomes count.
Point of return: choices are spread through the story, so keep choosing at every branch instead of skipping dialogue options.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description is a riddle — which second attempt counts is not confirmed from the official list alone.
steps: Fail an attempt at something, then succeed on the very next try.
The second-try success is what the trophy tracks, so do not reload an old save in between.
Point of return: keep a retryable attempt in mind during story missions with fail states.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.note: NOT PINNED DOWN YET: the official description is a riddle about something strange — the exact event is not confirmed from the official list alone.
steps: Explore the strange corners of Leonida — the odd, the hidden, the unexplained.
When something weird happens, stay and watch it through to the end.
Check the sources cited below for the event hunters have confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon, then line up a target on foot.
Drive past and strike with the melee weapon from the moving vehicle.
The trophy pops when the drive-by knocks the target over.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from heists and robberies, then launder them through your contacts.
Each laundered batch adds to the $250,000 total — dirty cash does not count until it is cleaned.
The counter stepper here tracks dollars laundered toward $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops in Leonida — clothes, food, gear, all of it counts.
Big-ticket items move the total fastest; the count is cumulative, not one purchase.
The counter stepper here tracks dollars spent toward $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida as they come on the market.
Each purchase needs the cash on hand — save up between story beats.
The counter stepper here tracks garages owned toward 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone in-game.
Register 10 different vehicles to the app — each new registration counts once.
The counter stepper here tracks vehicles registered toward 10.
